learning_outcomes.description: Understand Workplace Health and Safety Regulations

performance_criteria.description: Explain key OHS legislation and regulations relevant to Graphic Design sector.
Identify the roles and responsibilities of individuals and organizations in maintaining a safe work environment
Describe the process for reporting health and safety risks and incidents.

learning_outcomes.description: Identify Workplace Hazards and Implement Control Measures

performance_criteria.description: Identify common hazards in Graphic Design work environments
Assess the severity and likelihood of potential hazards in specific IT tasks.
Implement appropriate control measures, such as safe cabling practices, ergonomic workstation setup, and electrical safety protocols.

learning_outcomes.description: Apply Emergency Procedures and First Aid in the Workplace

performance_criteria.description: Demonstrate the correct procedure for responding to workplace emergencies, such as electrical fires or equipment malfunctions.
Perform basic first aid techniques, including treating minor injuries and using first aid equipment
Communicate effectively with emergency services and other relevant personnel during a workplace incident.

learning_outcomes.description: Understand the Roles and Responsibilities within a Team

performance_criteria.description: Identify the different roles and functions within an Graphic Design team
Describe the key responsibilities and contributions of each team member.
Recognize the importance of each role in achieving the team's objectives.

learning_outcomes.description: Foster Positive Working Relationships within a Team

performance_criteria.description: Demonstrate techniques for effective interpersonal communication and conflict resolution in a team environment.
Show the ability to provide constructive feedback and actively listen to others' contributions
Promote inclusivity and collaboration among team members to ensure participation and engagement from all.

learning_outcomes.description: Contribute to Team Problem-Solving and Decision-Making

performance_criteria.description: Participate in group discussions to identify and analyse Graphic Design related problems.
Suggest innovative solutions and support team decision-making processes.
Evaluate the effectiveness of team decisions and propose improvements where necessary.

learning_outcomes.description: Communicate Technical Information Clearly and Accurately

performance_criteria.description: Explain Graphic Design concepts, procedures, and solutions in a manner appropriate to the audience, whether technical or non-technical.
Use industry-standard terminology correctly when describing technical processes
Adapt communication methods to suit the context, such as written reports, emails, or verbal presentations.
Use digital tools for communication, such as email, messaging platforms, and collaboration software (e.g., Slack, Teams).
Adhere to best practices for professional digital communication, including email etiquette and secure file sharing.
Use collaborative tools to share and receive feedback on documents, code, or project updates.

learning_outcomes.description: Listen and Respond Appropriately in a Professional Context

performance_criteria.description: Demonstrate active listening skills during team discussions or client meetings.
Respond to questions, concerns, and feedback clearly and effectively.
Clarify misunderstandings and summarize discussions to ensure mutual understanding.
